name: reels-master
description: Chrome extension for Instagram Reels with volume control and download functionality

scripts.dev: BROWSER=chrome BUILD_ENTRY=background vite build && BROWSER=chrome BUILD_ENTRY=content vite build --watch
scripts.dev:firefox: BROWSER=firefox BUILD_ENTRY=background vite build && BROWSER=firefox BUILD_ENTRY=content vite build --watch
scripts.build:chrome: BROWSER=chrome BUILD_ENTRY=background vite build && BROWSER=chrome BUILD_ENTRY=content vite build
scripts.build:firefox: BROWSER=firefox BUILD_ENTRY=background vite build && BROWSER=firefox BUILD_ENTRY=content vite build
